race.comment: NOMORENIGHTSHIFT (13) talented gelding resuming with excellent fresh credentials. Back in trip and failed to stretch out in the heavy (8) going with a fading sixth over 1280m here last February. Fitted with the one trial and the cross-over nose band goes on. Can finish over the top of these. HELLCIBELL (6) tough mare who held a forward position to run a respectable third over 1400m at Grafton in the Mother's Gift. Back to her preferred trip and has solid top-three prospects. DEION (7) will appreciate the big weight drop and looking for this trip third-up. Covered plenty of ground in the run with a plugging fifth over 1000m at Dubbo. Drawn out and stays in the calculations. OAKFIELD DUKE (1) consistent gelding who savaged the line first-up with a narrow second over 1100m at Hawkesbury. Goes just as well second-up and has a solid record over this course and distance. Poorly drawn but must be respected. RUN RORY RUN (10) good fresh gelding who strips fitter for this. Place best.
